newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian forex market inactive as Bombay banks shut.
newsitem.headline: Indian forex market inactive as Bombay banks shut.

text.p: The Indian foreign exchange market was largely inactive on Friday as banks in Bombay, the financial capital, were closed for a Moslem holiday, dealers said.
The rupee ended Thursday at 35.6950/7025 after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) interevened for the sixth successive trading day to arrest the rupee's rise against the dollar, they said.
The rupee has been rising against the dollar because of large capital inflows stemming from foreign direct and portfolio investment as well as external commercial borrowings by Indian firms.
The rupee is expected to open at 35.70/71 on Monday.
